description: This test file contains unit tests for functions related to external plugin compatibility validation in the openclaw project. It uses Vitest as the testing framework and tests functions like normalizeExternalPluginCompatibility, listMissingExternalCodePluginFieldPaths, and validateExternalCodePluginPackageJson, focusing on OpenClaw plugin compatibility and required field validation.

methods.name: normalizeExternalPluginCompatibility
methods.description: Normalizes the compatibility information in an external plugin package.json, producing a standardized compatibility object.

methods.name: listMissingExternalCodePluginFieldPaths
methods.description: Lists the required field paths that are missing from a plugin package.json.

methods.name: validateExternalCodePluginPackageJson
methods.description: Validates the external plugin package.json for missing required fields and reports issues.
